{'text': 'Apple Music 正式推出全新品牌設計，包括新標誌及多項更新。Apple 在一段介紹品牌重塑的影片中透露，新形象其實是「由聲音打造」。', 'paragraph_context': 'Apple Music has officially launched its rebrand with a new design, logo, and more. And in a video detailing the rebrand, Apple reveals the new look was actually "made by sound."'}

{'text': 'Apple Music 正式換上新形象，並公開新標誌的幕後製作過程', 'paragraph_context': 'Apple Music officially launches rebrand, publishes behind-the-scenes of new logo'}

{'text': '過去數週已有跡象顯示 Apple Music 將進行大規模品牌重塑，包括 iOS 27.2 中出現的全新應用程式圖示及其他設計更新。', 'paragraph_context': "We've seen signs for weeks that Apple Music had a big rebrand coming, including a fresh app icon and other design updates in iOS 27.2."}

{'text': '如今 Apple 正式揭曉全新面貌，並表示這次設計是「由聲音打造」。', 'paragraph_context': 'Now Apple has officially unveiled its new look and shared that it was "made by sound."'}

{'text': '一個關於音樂、協作與匠心的故事，由 Fred again.. 與 NEST Acoustics 共同呈現。探索聲音如何令 Apple Music 標誌活現眼前，全程以攝影機實景拍攝。讓音樂，化為可見。', 'paragraph_context': 'A story of music, collaboration and craft with Fred again.. and NEST Acoustics.
